FIELDS.NAME: Harmony Discount Department Store
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS:
Harmony Discount Department Store operates as a physical retail establishment located in Springfield, IL, specializing in a wide range of affordable products including clothing, household goods, toys, and seasonal items. With an emphasis on value, we aim to provide our customers with high-quality merchandise at competitive prices. Our operations are focused entirely on retail sales, with less than 10% of our revenue coming from repair services, ensuring a primary retail focus in accordance with regulatory guidelines. We maintain a safe shopping environment with robust loss prevention measures and a dedicated staff trained in customer service and safety protocols. Our store hours accommodate a diverse customer base, and we pride ourselves on compliance with all local, state, and federal retail regulations.

Compliance Confirmation: The business does not derive more than 75% of its revenue from online sales and confirms that it does not operate as a supermarket, convenience store, self-storage facility, pawnshop, tobacconist, or adult-themed business. Additionally, incidental repair operations constitute less than 10% of our revenue, and we do not have on-premises cooking or commercial kitchens. We affirm full compliance with all eligibility requirements.
FIELDS.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: Losses incurred due to burglary on 02/15/2023, where merchandise valued at $10,000 was stolen; currently under investigation. Additionally, a slip and fall incident on 06/22/2023 led to a total payout of $15,000 for medical expenses; claim has been settled and closed.
FIELDS.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Commercial Grade Safe - Class B - UL Rated.
FIELDS.OTHER PROTECTION: Security fencing and trained security personnel.
